name: Idle check-ins get a small face or nothing
case: A quick turn finishes and then the person is around but nothing happens for fifty minutes, with the session open. Boop checks in now and then: a bored, lazy, calm or comfy face, or nothing, never a finish, and its mood barely moves.
why: The idle heartbeat comes every 15 to 30 minutes for two hours after the last activity while a session is open (TranscriptView.idleWindowMs, boop's idle_heartbeat 900-1800); PERSONALITY: an idle check-in gets a small face or nothing, and moves the mood only to fade it
